propositions: A declared-none file impact scope permits a signed plan attestation to remain valid after unrelated commits without re-hashing dependencies, unlike undeclared empty-impact tickets which fall back to whole-HEAD freshness check
The classifier contract distinguishes three scopes: non-empty dependency paths as 'paths', empty paths with explicit 'none' scope as 'none', and all other empty sets as 'unscoped'
The manifest emits an authenticated 'file-scope: none' declaration only when scope is none; paths and unscoped outputs remain byte-identical to pre-feature serialization
A none-scoped attestation recovers correctly through resign_plan_review while preserving its authenticated scope signature
Material fingerprint adds a canonical 'file_impact_scope' JSON member only for none scope; scope flip or reason-only change yields stale-material
Legacy readers ignore the additive file-scope line and treat missing scope as unscoped; none-scoped records created by new code recompute as stale-material after rollback
